title: Navigate and Verify Insights View for Functional Tests
description: Verify that users can access and view the Insights view for Functional tests
testDescription: This test ensures that users can navigate to the Insights view for Functional tests and that the page loads correctly with all expected UI components.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access test insights.
3. At least one functional test must have been executed previously to generate insights data.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the main dashboard page.
2. Click on the 'Insights' navigation item.
3. Select 'Functional Tests' from the test type dropdown or tab bar.
4. Wait for the page to fully load.
expectedResult:
1. Insights view for Functional tests should load successfully.
2. The page title should indicate 'Functional Test Insights' or similar.
3. All UI components should be visible including metrics dashboard, charts, and filters.
4. No error messages should be displayed.
dataRequirements: Existing functional test results must be available in the database

title: Verify Data Presentation in Functional Tests Insights View
description: Ensure that all data elements in the Functional Tests Insights view are correctly presented and match the source data
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Tests Insights view correctly displays all test metrics, charts, and result data that matches the underlying data source.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have navigated to the Functional Tests Insights view.
3. Functional test results must exist in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Identify key metrics displayed on the Insights dashboard (pass rate, failure rate, test duration, etc.).
2. Note the values of these metrics.
3. Navigate to the raw data source or test results page.
4. Compare the metrics from the Insights view with the raw data.
5. Check all charts and graphs for correct visualization of data.
6. Verify test history trends display correctly.
expectedResult:
1. All metrics in the Insights view should match the source data exactly.
2. Charts and graphs should accurately represent the underlying data.
3. Color coding should be consistent (green for passes, red for failures, etc.).
4. Test history trends should accurately reflect changes over time.
5. Data presentation should match the pattern used in Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.
dataRequirements: Access to raw test results data for verification

title: Test Filtering and Sorting Capabilities in Functional Tests Insights View
description: Verify that filtering and sorting functions work correctly in the Functional Tests Insights view
testDescription: This test validates that users can filter and sort data in the Functional Tests Insights view and that the results are accurate.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have navigated to the Functional Tests Insights view.
3. Multiple test results with various statuses, durations, and dates must exist.
stepsToPerform:
1. Identify all available filter controls on the page.
2. Apply a filter for test status (e.g., 'Failed tests only').
3. Verify filtered results.
4. Apply a date range filter.
5. Verify date-filtered results.
6. Apply sorting on different columns (e.g., duration, test name).
7. Verify sorted results.
8. Apply multiple filters simultaneously.
9. Clear all filters.
10. Refresh page and verify if filter state is maintained.
expectedResult:
1. Applying filters should immediately update the displayed data.
2. Only data matching the filter criteria should be displayed.
3. Sorting should correctly reorder the data according to selected column and direction.
4. Multiple filters should work in combination to narrow results appropriately.
5. Clearing filters should restore all data.
6. Filter state should be maintained after page refresh.
7. Filtering behavior should be consistent with Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.
dataRequirements: Test data with various statuses, durations, and execution dates

title: Compare Functional Tests Insights View with Other Test Type Insights
description: Ensure consistency between Functional Tests Insights and other test type insights views
testDescription: This test verifies that the Functional Tests Insights view follows the same patterns and behaviors as existing Insights views for Unit, Integration, and API tests.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access all test insight views.
3. Results must exist for all test types (Unit, Integration, API, and Functional).
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Tests Insights view.
2. Take note of layout, available filters, charts, and metrics.
3. Navigate to the Unit Tests Insights view.
4. Compare layout and functionality with Functional Tests view.
5. Repeat comparison for Integration Tests Insights view.
6. Repeat comparison for API Tests Insights view.
7. Test navigation between different insight views.
8. Verify consistency of common UI elements and behaviors across all views.
expectedResult:
1. Layout structure should be consistent across all Insights views.
2. Common features (filtering, sorting, drill-down) should behave the same way.
3. Navigation between different test type insights should work smoothly.
4. Style, typography, and color scheme should be consistent.
5. Common metrics should be labeled and calculated the same way across views.
6. Any test type-specific metrics should be clearly distinguished.
7. Switching between views should maintain selected global filters when applicable.
dataRequirements: Access to all test type insight views and corresponding test results

title: Validate Error Handling and Edge Cases in Functional Tests Insights View
description: Verify proper handling of error conditions and edge cases in the Functional Tests Insights view
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Tests Insights view properly handles error conditions, edge cases, and unusual data situations.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access test insights.
3. Various test scenarios must be available, including edge cases.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Tests Insights with no functional test data in the system.
2. Navigate to Functional Tests Insights with an extremely large number of test results.
3. Apply filters that result in no matching data.
4. Intentionally cause network interruption while loading the insights data.
5. Test with functional tests that have unusually long names or descriptions.
6. Test with extremely short and extremely long test durations.
7. Verify behavior with tests that have incomplete metadata.
8. Test rendering with special characters in test names and descriptions.
expectedResult:
1. When no data exists, an appropriate message should be displayed instead of empty charts.
2. Large data sets should load efficiently without browser performance issues.
3. 'No results found' message should appear when filters match no data.
4. Network interruptions should be handled gracefully with retry options or error messages.
5. Long text should be properly truncated or wrapped in the UI.
6. Edge case durations should be displayed appropriately without breaking the UI.
7. Tests with incomplete metadata should still display with available information and indicate missing data.
8. Special characters should render correctly without breaking the layout.
dataRequirements: Test data representing various edge cases and error conditions

title: Verify Performance of Functional Tests Insights View with Large Datasets
description: Ensure the Functional Tests Insights view maintains performance and responsiveness when displaying large volumes of test data
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Tests Insights view maintains acceptable performance metrics when loading, displaying, and filtering large volumes of functional test data.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access test insights.
3. A large dataset of functional test results must be available in the system (minimum 1000 test records).
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Tests Insights view.
2. Measure the initial page load time.
3. Apply several different filters and measure response time for each filter operation.
4. Sort the data by different columns and measure the sorting operation time.
5. Export the full dataset and measure the export operation time.
6. Scroll through paginated results and measure rendering time for each page.
7. Apply complex filter combinations and measure response time.
8. Refresh the page with filters applied and measure load time.
expectedResult:
1. Initial page load should complete within 3 seconds.
2. Filter operations should respond within 1 second.
3. Sorting operations should complete within 1 second.
4. Data export should initiate within 2 seconds.
5. Pagination should render new pages within 1 second.
6. Complex filter combinations should respond within 2 seconds.
7. Page refresh with filters should maintain performance standards.
8. No UI freezing, lagging, or browser performance warnings should occur.
dataRequirements: Large volume of functional test results (1000+ records with varied statuses, durations, and dates)
performanceThresholds: Initial load <3s, Filter operations <1s, Sort operations <1s, Export initiation <2s

title: Test Data Export Functionality from Functional Tests Insights View
description: Verify that users can successfully export data from the Functional Tests Insights view in various formats
testDescription: This test validates the export functionality of the Functional Tests Insights view, ensuring users can export test data in various formats with correct content.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access and export test insights.
3. Functional test results must exist in the system.
4. User must have navigated to the Functional Tests Insights view.
stepsToPerform:
1. Locate and click the export button or menu option.
2. Select CSV format export and initiate download.
3. Open the downloaded CSV file and verify content matches displayed data.
4. Return to insights view and select PDF format export.
5. Verify PDF generation and download.
6. Open PDF and verify content accuracy.
7. Return to insights view and apply filters for specific test results.
8. Export the filtered data and verify only filtered data is included.
9. Test export with extremely large result sets.
expectedResult:
1. Export options should be clearly accessible from the Insights view.
2. CSV exports should contain all relevant columns with correct data.
3. PDF exports should be formatted properly with all relevant information.
4. Exported data should accurately reflect what is displayed in the UI.
5. Filtered exports should only include the filtered data.
6. Large dataset exports should complete successfully without timeout or errors.
7. Export functionality should behave consistently with Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.
dataRequirements: Various functional test results including different statuses, durations, and metadata
exportFormats: CSV, PDF, Potentially Excel or JSON if supported

title: Verify Detailed Test Drill-Down in Functional Tests Insights View
description: Ensure users can drill down from high-level metrics to detailed test results in the Functional Tests Insights view
testDescription: This test validates that users can navigate from high-level metrics and summaries to detailed individual test results within the Functional Tests Insights view.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access test insights.
3. Functional test results with detailed information must exist in the system.
4. User must have navigated to the Functional Tests Insights view.
stepsToPerform:
1. Identify and click on a summary metric (e.g., failed tests count).
2. Verify navigation to a filtered view showing only the relevant tests.
3. Select an individual test from the list.
4. Verify the test details panel/page opens.
5. Verify all test details are displayed correctly (steps, screenshots, logs, etc.).
6. Navigate back to the summary view.
7. Click on a different metric or chart segment.
8. Verify appropriate filtering and display of relevant tests.
9. Test navigation breadcrumbs for returning to previous views.
expectedResult:
1. Clicking on summary metrics should filter the view to show only relevant tests.
2. Selecting an individual test should display complete test details.
3. Test details should include all relevant information (steps, screenshots, logs, assertions, etc.).
4. Navigation between summary and detail views should work seamlessly.
5. Breadcrumbs or back buttons should allow easy navigation to previous views.
6. Drill-down functionality should behave consistently with Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.
dataRequirements: Functional test results with complete details including steps, screenshots, and logs
navigationPath: Summary metrics → Filtered test list → Individual test details

title: Test Cross-Browser Compatibility of Functional Tests Insights View
description: Verify that the Functional Tests Insights view renders and functions correctly across different browsers
testDescription: This test ensures that the Functional Tests Insights view maintains consistent appearance, functionality, and performance across multiple browsers and versions.
prerequisites:
1. User must have access to multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
2. Test accounts with appropriate permissions must be available.
3. Functional test results must exist in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Functional Tests Insights view in Chrome.
2. Document the layout, positioning, and appearance of all UI elements.
3. Perform basic operations (filtering, sorting, exporting).
4. Repeat steps 1-3 in Firefox.
5. Repeat steps 1-3 in Safari.
6. Repeat steps 1-3 in Edge.
7. Compare screenshots of the view across all browsers.
8. Test responsive design by resizing browser windows to different dimensions.
9. Verify any animations, transitions, or interactive elements work consistently.
expectedResult:
1. UI layout and appearance should be consistent across all browsers.
2. All functionality (filtering, sorting, exporting, drill-down) should work identically across browsers.
3. Performance metrics should be comparable across browsers.
4. No browser-specific rendering issues, JavaScript errors, or CSS problems should occur.
5. Responsive design should adapt appropriately to different window sizes in all browsers.
6. All charts, graphs, and data visualizations should render correctly across browsers.
dataRequirements: Functional test results with diverse data characteristics

title: Verify Custom Dashboard Creation in Functional Tests Insights View
description: Ensure users can create, save, and load custom dashboards within the Functional Tests Insights view
testDescription: This test validates that users can create customized dashboards by selecting specific metrics, charts, and data views that are important to them, and save these configurations for future use.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to create custom dashboards.
3. Functional test results must exist in the system.
4. User must have navigated to the Functional Tests Insights view.
stepsToPerform:
1. Locate and click the 'Create Custom Dashboard' or equivalent option.
2. Select several metrics and charts to add to the custom dashboard.
3. Arrange the selected elements in a custom layout.
4. Save the dashboard with a unique name.
5. Navigate away from the custom dashboard.
6. Locate and load the previously saved custom dashboard.
7. Verify all selected elements and their arrangement.
8. Modify the custom dashboard by adding/removing elements.
9. Save the modifications.
10. Test sharing the custom dashboard with another user if the feature exists.
expectedResult:
1. Custom dashboard creation interface should be intuitive and functional.
2. Users should be able to select from all available metrics and charts.
3. Custom layout capabilities should function correctly.
4. Dashboard saving should complete successfully.
5. Saved dashboards should appear in a list of available dashboards.
6. Loading a saved dashboard should restore the exact configuration.
7. Dashboard modifications should save correctly.
8. Shared dashboards should be accessible to other users with appropriate permissions.
9. Custom dashboard functionality should be consistent with similar features in Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.
dataRequirements: Variety of functional test metrics and charts that can be added to custom dashboards
userPermissions: Dashboard creation and sharing permissions required

title: Test Mobile Responsiveness of Functional Tests Insights View
description: Verify that the Functional Tests Insights view properly adapts to mobile devices and maintains usability
testDescription: This test verifies that the Functional Tests Insights view is fully responsive on mobile devices, maintaining usability and functionality while adapting to smaller screen sizes.
prerequisites:
1. Mobile device or emulator with various screen sizes available.
2. User must be able to log in to the application on mobile devices.
3. Functional test results must exist in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access the application on a mobile device or using a device emulator.
2. Log in with valid credentials.
3. Navigate to the Insights section.
4. Select Functional Tests Insights view.
5. Observe layout adaptation to mobile screen.
6. Test interaction with charts and metrics using touch controls.
7. Test filtering and sorting using mobile interface.
8. Rotate device between portrait and landscape orientations.
9. Test pinch-to-zoom functionality on charts and graphs.
expectedResult:
1. Functional Tests Insights view should automatically adapt to mobile screen size.
2. All important metrics and charts should be visible without horizontal scrolling.
3. Touch controls should work properly for all interactive elements.
4. Filter and sort controls should be accessible and usable on mobile.
5. Layout should adjust appropriately when switching between portrait and landscape.
6. Pinch-to-zoom should work on charts and detailed views when needed.
7. No UI elements should overlap or become inaccessible on mobile.
browsers: Mobile Chrome, Mobile Safari, Mobile Firefox
deviceTypes: Smartphone (iPhone 12, Galaxy S21), Tablet (iPad, Galaxy Tab)

title: Verify Real-Time Updates in Functional Tests Insights View
description: Ensure that the Functional Tests Insights view updates in real-time when new test results are available
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Tests Insights view receives and displays updates in real-time or through proper refresh mechanisms when new functional test results become available.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access test insights.
3. A functional test execution environment must be available for running new tests.
4. User must be on the Functional Tests Insights view.
stepsToPerform:
1. Note current metrics and test results displayed in the Insights view.
2. In another tab or window, trigger execution of new functional tests.
3. Monitor the Insights view for automatic updates.
4. If automatic updates don't occur, use any available refresh controls.
5. Verify metrics are updated to include new test results.
6. Run tests with different outcomes (pass, fail) and observe updates.
7. Check update behavior when tests with longer durations complete.
expectedResult:
1. Insights view should update automatically when new test results are available, or clearly indicate that new results are available.
2. If manual refresh is required, refreshing should incorporate new test results into metrics and visualizations.
3. All charts, graphs, and metrics should reflect the newly added test results.
4. Real-time or refresh behavior should be consistent with Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.
5. Update mechanism should not disrupt user's current view or selections.
6. Any real-time notification system should correctly alert when new results are available.

title: Test Accessibility Compliance of Functional Tests Insights View
description: Verify that the Functional Tests Insights view meets accessibility standards and works with assistive technologies
testDescription: This test ensures that the Functional Tests Insights view complies with accessibility standards (WCAG) and functions properly with assistive technologies such as screen readers and keyboard navigation.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access test insights.
3. Screen reader software must be installed (e.g., NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver).
4. User must have navigated to the Functional Tests Insights view.
stepsToPerform:
1. Enable the screen reader software.
2. Navigate through the Insights view using only keyboard controls (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys).
3. Verify screen reader properly announces all elements and their states.
4. Check that all charts and visualizations have proper alt text or ARIA labels.
5. Test color contrast using accessibility evaluation tools.
6. Verify that interactive elements can be operated using only the keyboard.
7. Check that focus indicators are visible and clear.
8. Test page with text zoom increased to 200%.
expectedResult:
1. All elements should be navigable using keyboard only.
2. Screen reader should announce all elements, including charts and their data.
3. All interactive elements should have proper ARIA roles and states.
4. Color contrast should meet WCAG AA standards at minimum.
5. Focus indicators should be clearly visible during keyboard navigation.
6. Content should remain usable when text is zoomed to 200%.
7. No functionality should be dependent solely on mouse interactions.
8. Accessibility implementation should be consistent with Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.

title: Test User Permission Controls for Functional Tests Insights View
description: Verify that the Functional Tests Insights view respects user permission levels and restricts access appropriately
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Tests Insights view correctly enforces user permissions, showing only data that users are authorized to access and enabling actions based on permission levels.
prerequisites:
1. Multiple test user accounts with different permission levels must be available:
   - Admin user with full permissions
   - Standard user with view-only permissions
   - Limited user with restricted project access
2. Functional test results must exist in the system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an admin user.
2. Navigate to Functional Tests Insights view.
3. Note all available features, data, and actions.
4. Log out and log in as a standard user.
5. Navigate to Functional Tests Insights view.
6. Compare available features and data with admin user experience.
7. Attempt to perform restricted actions (e.g., delete reports, modify dashboards).
8. Log out and log in as a limited user.
9. Verify this user can only see projects they have access to.
10. Attempt to access restricted projects via direct URLs.
expectedResult:
1. Admin user should have access to all features and data.
2. Standard user should have view-only access with no ability to modify shared dashboards or delete reports.
3. Limited user should only see data from projects they have permission to access.
4. Attempting restricted actions should result in appropriate error messages or disabled controls.
5. Direct URL attempts to access unauthorized data should be blocked with proper error messages.
6. Permission behavior should be consistent with Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.

title: Verify Historical Trend Analysis in Functional Tests Insights View
description: Ensure that the Functional Tests Insights view correctly displays historical trends and allows comparative analysis
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Tests Insights view properly displays historical trends over time and allows users to compare test metrics across different time periods.
prerequisites:
1. User must be logged into the application.
2. User must have permissions to access test insights.
3. Functional test results from multiple time periods (days, weeks, months) must exist in the system.
4. User must have navigated to the Functional Tests Insights view.
stepsToPerform:
1. Locate trend visualization sections in the Insights view.
2. Verify test execution trends are displayed over time (line charts, bar charts, etc.).
3. Change the time period selection (last week, last month, last quarter, etc.).
4. Verify the trend data updates accordingly.
5. Select two different time periods for comparison.
6. Verify comparative analysis displays correctly.
7. Hover over trend data points to check tooltip information.
8. Verify key performance indicators show trend direction (improving/declining).
9. Test any trend export functionality.
expectedResult:
1. Historical trends should be visually displayed with appropriate charts.
2. Time period selectors should function correctly and update the displayed data.
3. Trend direction should be clearly indicated (up/down arrows, color coding).
4. Comparative analysis between different time periods should display accurately.
5. Tooltip information on trend charts should show detailed metrics for specific points in time.
6. Long-term trends should be accurately calculated and displayed.
7. Trend visualization should be consistent with Unit, Integration, and API test Insights views.
8. Any anomalies in the trend data should be highlighted or flagged.
